name: Health Master
description: Tracks the family's meals and calories, and proposes a concrete dinner plan every day at 16:00 — grounded in what was actually eaten, never invented.
description_zh: 跟踪全家的饮食与热量，每天 16:00 给出具体的晚餐方案——基于真实记录，绝不凭空编造。

suggested_channels.reason: Family members report meals and ask diet questions over the WeChat gateway.
suggested_channels.reason_zh: 家人通过微信网关上报三餐、咨询饮食问题。

suggested_channels.reason: A kitchen device (display/speaker) can receive the dinner plan where it is cooked.
suggested_channels.reason_zh: 厨房设备（屏幕/音箱）可以在做饭的地方直接收到晚餐方案。

suggested_context.reason: Allergies, dietary restrictions, and health goals curated by the operator make plans safe and personal.
suggested_context.reason_zh: 由主人维护的过敏、忌口与健康目标信息，让方案安全且个性化。

schedule.label: Dinner plan
schedule.prompt: Review today's logged meals and calories for each family member, then propose tonight's dinner: dishes, portions per person, and why — balancing what is missing from today's intake. Publish it to the granted channels.
